sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.hint: Click a card to open the workspace; ↗ opens the folder.

live.empty: Live captions will appear here once recording starts.

settings.title: Transcribe parameters
settings.model_hint: small = fast, lower accuracy. large-v3-turbo = much better accuracy, slower on CPU (bigger backlog). Download ggml-<model>.bin into ~/.mori/models/ first (see Deps tab).
settings.silence_split_hint: How long a pause counts as a sentence break. Lower = snappier captions but more fragments.
settings.silence_threshold_hint: Below this volume is treated as silence.
settings.min_speech_hint: Sounds shorter than this (noise) are not transcribed.
settings.max_segment_hint: Force a cut after speaking continuously this long.
settings.language_hint: Force whisper to this language (default Chinese). 'Auto' lets it detect.
settings.traditional_hint: Converts Simplified output to Taiwan Traditional via OpenCC (needs the opencc tool installed; otherwise no-op).

workspace.diar_wait: Please wait, this may take a few minutes
workspace.diar_no_model_hint: Please download the diarization model in the Deps tab first
workspace.merge_hint: {{count}} selected — first becomes the primary speaker
workspace.diar_rerun_confirm: This will re-cluster speakers and reset any custom names. Continue?

deps.title: Dependency check
deps.hint: Requires whisper.cpp CLI + a GGML model. Copy the install command below into your terminal.
deps.download_model_hint: Downloads {{file}} into ~/.mori/models/. The full-install below only fetches ggml-small — use this to get large-v3-turbo (or re-fetch any model).
deps.gpu_on_hint: Transcription runs on your GPU automatically — no need to check with nvidia-smi.
deps.gpu_steps_cuda: NVIDIA GPU detected but CUDA toolkit is missing. Run ① to install CUDA, then ② to rebuild whisper-cli (auto-builds with GPU) — turbo will then run on the GPU.
deps.gpu_steps_rebuild: CUDA toolkit present. Run the command below to rebuild whisper-cli (auto-builds with GPU) — turbo will then run on the GPU.
deps.gpu_steps_win: NVIDIA GPU detected but this is the CPU build. Run the command below to reinstall — it auto-grabs the cuBLAS (GPU) build (bundles the CUDA runtime, no toolkit needed) — turbo will then run on the GPU.
deps.gpu_no_hint: No NVIDIA GPU — staying on CPU (the small model is smoother there).
deps.diar_model_hint: Used to automatically identify speakers after transcription. Download takes a few minutes.
